---
name: Constraint idea
about: Suggest a new challenge card for StopDown
title: "Constraint idea: "
labels: constraint-idea
---

**The card, as it would read on screen**
e.g. "Shoot only reflections in puddles."

**Why it's worth doing** (one or two sentences, this becomes the "Why?" text)

**Category**
Lens, Aperture, Shutter, Focus, Exposure, Light direction, Light source, Flash, Shapes, Framing, Viewpoint, Subject, Concept, Session limits, or Output & edit

**Difficulty:** 1 (easy), 2 or 3 (hard)

**Gear it needs** (if any): tripod, flash, ND filter, macro lens…

**Only works…** (if relevant): in daylight / golden hour / at night, indoors / outdoors

**Clashes with** (if any): cards it shouldn't be paired with
